format: NetCDF4 BODY segments inside a product zip
origin: EUMETSAT Data Store via eumdac (collections EO:EUM:DAT:0662 FDHSI, EO:EUM:DAT:0665 HRFI)
disabled_reason: needs EUMETSAT Data Store credentials (EUMETSAT_CONSUMER_KEY / EUMETSAT_CONSUMER_SECRET, or the eumdac file ~/.eumdac/credentials, meteosat_fci.py:395, utils_eumetsat.py). Also cannot run through the generic single-instance path with the full model list: one MeteosatFCI instance serves one resolution only (_check_resolution_consistency, meteosat_fci.py:828-852); at 2km only the last 8 variables (fci38ir..fci133ir) are valid, the first 8 (VIS/NIR) need a second instance with resolution='1km'.
notes: Variables are the exact StormScopeMeteosatEU input list (stormscope_meteosat.py:56-73 VARIABLES). The example builds TWO sources (2km and 1km, 1km bbox = 2x the 2km bbox) and fetches 8 variables from each (examples/04_nowcasting/04_stormscope_meteosat_example.py:119-164).

ctor_kwargs reproduce the example's 2km instance: pixel_bbox = StormScopeMeteosatEU.Model_FCI_BBox (stormscope_meteosat.py:172-175). To make this spec runnable, cut variables to the last 8, or use resolution '1km' with pixel_bbox [[8640,10880],[3712,8576]] and the first 8.
The example also requests 6 frames (lead times -50..0 min); the harness fetches one time only.

Time must be on a 600 s grid and >= 2024-01-16 (meteosat_fci.py:125, :880-902). Each time downloads the whole full-disk product zip regardless of the variables or bbox requested (meteosat_fci.py:637-688).
load_model can override variables from package metadata (stormscope_meteosat.py:863); class default used, no checkpoint loaded.
